MarkLite 0.1.3 - Windows x64 portable build

File: mdlite.exe
Target: x86_64-pc-windows-gnu (Rust 1.99.1), release profile with LTO and strip
Requires: Windows 10/11 x64
Installer: none (portable single-file executable)

Includes:
- Multi-file tabs, multi-select open, dirty-state close/quit prompts
- Split editor with live preview
- Chinese/English UI, system/light/dark appearance, 5 accent colors
- Menu bar and Phosphor icons
- PDF and Word export
- Native macOS menu bar, About panel and native prompt dialogs
- System UI font loading and macOS native-style palette
- Author email and GitHub repository links in About/Help
- Remote image loading in preview and always-confirm when closing tabs
- Fixed native menu event delivery for Help links
- Embedded Common Controls v6 manifest to fix TaskDialogIndirect load errors on Windows

Notes:
- PDF export uses a locally installed Microsoft Edge or Google Chrome/Chromium.
- Word export generates .docx directly and does not require Office.
- This unsigned build may trigger a SmartScreen warning.
- Settings are stored in %APPDATA%\MarkLite\settings.json.

SHA256:
76163b837d2000ada4f76fe9576382673ea62ce6d91679cabd8ba6046d060838  mdlite.exe
